title: Purification and Identification of Peptides from Hydrilla verticillata (Linn. f.) Royle with Cytoprotective and Antioxidative Effect against H(2)O(2)-Treated HepG2 Cells.
authors: Tang, Yufang; Liang, Fan; Yan, Yue; Zeng, Yanlin; Li, Yuqin; Zhou, Rong
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物源抗氧化肽对H2O2损伤HepG2细胞的保护作用，涉及Keap1蛋白与肽的分子对接，但对象为蛋白-肽互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Antioxidant peptides were purified from Hydrilla verticillata (Linn. f.) Royle (HVR) protein hydrolysate by ultrafiltration, gel filtration chromatography, and semipreparative reversed-phase HPLC and identified by UPLC-ESI-MS/MS. Therein, TCLGPK and TCLGER were selected to be synthesized, and they displayed desirable radical-scavenging activity to ABTS (99.20 +/- 0.56-99.20 +/- 0.43%), DPPH (97.32 +/- 0.59-97.56 +/- 0.97%), hydroxyl radical (54.32 +/- 1.27-70.42 +/- 2.01%), and superoxide anion (42.93 +/- 1.46-52.62 +/- 1.11%) at a concentration of 0.96 mumol/mL. They possessed a cytoprotective effect against H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress in HepG2 cells in a dose-dependent manner. 1.6 mumol/mL of the two peptides could perfectly protect HepG2 cells from H(2)O(2)-induced injury. The TCLGPK exhibited higher antioxidant activity and cytoprotective effect than TCLGER. Western blot and molecular docking results indicated that the two peptides achieved antioxidant ability and cytoprotective effect by combining with Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) to activate the Keap1-nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)-antioxidant response elements signaling pathway, leading to the activity and expression of the related antioxidases in the pathway significantly up-regulating and the intracellular reactive oxygen species level, lipid peroxidation, and cell apoptosis rate significantly down-regulating.
abstract_zh: 通过超滤、凝胶过滤色谱和半制备反相高效液相色谱法，从水鳖（Hydrilla verticillata (Linn. f.) Royle, HVR）蛋白水解物中纯化出抗氧化肽，并利用UPLC-ESI-MS/MS进行鉴定。其中，选择合成了TCLGPK和TCLGER，它们在0.96 μmol/mL浓度下对ABTS（99.20 ± 0.56-99.20 ± 0.43%）、DPPH（97.32 ± 0.59-97.56 ± 0.97%）、羟基自由基（54.32 ± 1.27-70.42 ± 2.01%）和超氧阴离子（42.93 ± 1.46-52.62 ± 1.11%）表现出理想的自由基清除活性。它们对HepG2细胞中H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激具有剂量依赖性的细胞保护作用。1.6 μmol/mL的这两种肽能完全保护HepG2细胞免受H(2)O(2)诱导的损伤。TCLGPK表现出比TCLGER更高的抗氧化活性和细胞保护效果。Western blot和分子对接结果表明，这两种肽通过与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）结合，激活Keap1-核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）-抗氧化反应元件信号通路，从而实现抗氧化能力和细胞保护作用，导致该通路中相关抗氧化酶的活性和表达显著上调，细胞内活性氧水平、脂质过氧化和细胞凋亡率显著下调。
